story.headline: Claude is folding quick questions and longer Cowork jobs into one conversation

heroVisual.alt: An illustrated tablet beside appliance manuals shows one blank conversation leading to a checklist.

story.the_story:
Anthropic announced September 16 that it is merging Claude chat and Cowork into one Claude experience. A person can ask a quick question or hand over a longer, multi-step task without choosing a mode first.

Rollout is gradual: Pro and Max first across web, desktop and mobile. Team and Free follow; Enterprise gets at least 30 days’ notice. Same-plan accounts may differ.
story.laidies_read:
The change removes a doorway; it does not promise every task will succeed. Until your account moves, the closest alternative is separate Claude Chat for questions and Cowork for longer jobs.

LAiDIES would use the longer-work option when a task has named inputs and a document to check. Anthropic says Manual asks before actions; Auto reduces check-ins. The setting covers the conversation. Those are vendor descriptions, not proof a task will finish well.
story.what_this_means:
Once the new experience reaches your account, attach three appliance manuals and ask Claude to make an editable seasonal-maintenance checklist. Keep the conversation on Manual, name the manuals it may use and inspect every date or safety instruction against the originals.

Local work needs Claude Desktop open; cloud work may continue after the laptop closes. If separate Chat and Cowork choices remain, keep using them.
story.cocktail_party: “Claude is removing the mode choice, not the need to choose permissions.”
story.class_notes: Background: Working with AI 101 — Add to Your Working With AI Kit shows how to write one authority line: what an agent may do, when it must ask and when it must stop.

model-tool-release.productRange: One Claude conversation is replacing the separate Chat and Cowork choices as each account migrates.
model-tool-release.newCapabilities: Cowork-style multi-step tasks and finished-file creation become available from an ordinary conversation.
model-tool-release.bestFitTasks: A low-risk task with clear inputs and a result the reader can inspect, such as a household maintenance checklist.
model-tool-release.notFor: The sources do not establish reliable task completion, universal access, safety, privacy or independent quality.
model-tool-release.nearestAlternatives: Until migration, people who still see separate Chat and Cowork choices can keep using them as before.
model-tool-release.availability: Gradual rollout begins with Pro and Max on web, desktop and mobile; same-plan accounts may differ.
model-tool-release.freePaidBoundary: Pro and Max are first; Team and Free are due to follow; Enterprise organizations receive advance notice.
model-tool-release.costBoundary: The sources name plan order but do not announce a new price for the merged experience.
model-tool-release.limitations: Provider announcement and help documentation only; no independent usage or outcome evidence.
model-tool-release.technicalExampleProportionality: The article uses one original appliance-manual task and explains only the permission and execution boundaries needed for it.
model-tool-release.vendorEvidenceBoundary: Anthropic is the source for its own product, rollout and permission behavior; the article makes no performance claim.
